title: Where Dick Allen first heard him; Allen's Georgia roots and army years
summary: Allen says he heard the band at Haydell's about 1950-51; talk drifts to Allen's Georgia hometown and where Ferbos and Dejan were stationed.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Were you at Haydell's, that must have been after World War II, huh? Because I was down here. Oh definitely. Yeah, I was down here.
I think it was, I'm pretty sure it was after World War II.
It was around, it couldn't have been.
You were in the service, weren't you?

Yeah, I was down here when I was in the service in forty-five, but I didn't hear you until I came back. I came back in forty-nine, you see, the end of forty-nine, September. So it must have been about 1950 or 51 when I heard you.
I don't know yet. My wife fussed me all the time.
Who was playing when you heard him in fifty or what?
Well around that time it was down at Haydell's Melody Inn.
Oh, with Haroldin. Yeah, with Haroldin now. I thought you heard him while he was in your home at you? No, no, no.
I didn't know him then. I didn't know many guys, you know, it was hard to get around.
You know where he's from actually, the way he's from? Where did your home be? Georgia originally.
Which place, Atlanta? No, outside of Atlanta, about a hundred miles, right in the center of the state, Milledgeville. It's near Macon.
Oh, in other words, you'd be heading from here to Washington, say going to Atlanta, would you pass near your place or not?
If you were going to Washington you might pass through it, but it's not on the way to Atlanta.
Well not on the way to Atlanta. But I mean after Atlanta, would you pass going to Washington?
No, you wouldn't pass right now.

Oh, well, well, because I was out where he was, but I was, when you say he was around the coast of Macon, I was in Macon, Georgia, the ice station down there. But I was down here. Robin Field, I was supposed to Savannah, Savannah, Georgia, all that stuff.
I was down here. Because I went to Washington, my son was at that edgewood, right outside of Baltimore,
and we went through Atlanta. Augusta, I was out there, I stood in Augusta about 18 months.
